Their field must've gone critical. Probably slipped a superconductor coupling.''"
"''No way. My crew went over the housing this morning. Checked the seals three times—those vacuum bubbles were tight. A greased neutrino couldn't have squeezed between the plates.|The lieutenant and an Ishi Tib, on the explosion|}} A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. During his stay on the planet, the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] witnessed the explosion of a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] transporting [[Bota/Legends|bota]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with substantial medicinal qualities. Together with two other beings, the lieutenant speculated on what had caused the explosion. ==Biography== {{Quote|How many aboard?''"
"''Two loaders. And the pilot.|The lieutenant and a Human|}} [[File:JangoFett-OffPix.png|thumb|right|200px|Jango Fett (pictured) was the template for the Galactic Republic's Clone Army]] Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} the [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and was [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] served on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Drongar|clashed]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the planet's fields of [[Bota/Legends|bota]]—a highly valuable [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that had extensive medicinal assets. During his stay on Drongar, the lieutenant witnessed the explosion of a bota [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]]. While the lieutenant suspected that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had exploded due to a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] failure, a nearby [[Unidentified Ishi Tib technician|Ishi Tib technician]] stated that such an event was impossible. The lieutenant then asked how many beings had been aboard the vessel, and a [[Unidentified Human (Drongar)|Human]] informed him that there had been two loaders and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the carrier. Unbeknownst to the Republic, the traitor [[Klo Merit]] had [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the vessel. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Freaking shame.|The lieutenant, regarding the deaths caused by the explosion|}} After seeing the explosion of the carrier, the lieutenant whistled in awe and was quick to assume the event had been caused by shield failure. After being told otherwise, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] asked how many lives the tragedy had claimed and considered the [[Death/Legends|loss]] of three people a shame. Like all clone troopers, he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall ands had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin. ==Equipment== As a lieutenant, the clone trooper wore blue [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]]. ==Behind the scenes== The clone lieutenant had a brief appearance in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. ''Battle Surgeons'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], and was published in [[2004]]. ==Appearances== *''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' {{1st|MedStar I: Battle Surgeons (abridged audiobook)}} *''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons (abridged audiobook)]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone trooper lieutenants]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
